import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivGrassmannianEmbedding
import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivGrassmannianAmbient

/-!
# Rank of line-bundle pushforward on a proper smooth curve

The pushforward to the ground field of a line bundle on a proper smooth
geometrically integral curve is locally free of rank equal to the dimension
of its global sections. The proof identifies the two ground-field actions,
transports finite-dimensionality of curve sections, and applies the affine
local-freeness criterion. This supplies the actual ambient module for the
divisor Grassmannian in campaign D2 toward Kleiman's divisor representability.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

universe u

open CategoryTheory Limits

namespace AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme

variable {k : Type u} [Field k]

attribute [local instance] moduleKSections

set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
/-- The ground-field action on curve sections is the structure-map action
through `ΓSpecIso`; this is the scalar bridge for pushforward top sections. -/
lemma moduleKSections_smul_top (C : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)))
    (L : C.left.Modules) (a : k) (x : Γ(L, (⊤ : C.left.Opens))) :
    a • x = C.hom.appTop.hom ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of k)).inv.hom a) • x := by
  change (show Γ(C.left, (⊤ : C.left.Opens)) from
    (toModuleKSheaf.kToSection C (Opposite.op ⊤)).hom a) • x = _
  have he : (toModuleKSheaf.kToSection C (Opposite.op ⊤)).hom =
      C.hom.appTop.hom.comp (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of k)).inv.hom := by
    unfold toModuleKSheaf.kToSection
    have hid : (homOfLE (show (⊤ : C.left.Opens) ≤ ⊤ from le_top)).op =
        𝟙 (Opposite.op (⊤ : C.left.Opens)) := rfl
    rw [hid]
    erw [CategoryTheory.Functor.map_id, Category.comp_id]
    rfl
  rw [he]
  rfl

set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
/-- The affine pushforward section module is finite projective over the ground
field, and its dimension is the dimension of the original curve sections. -/
theorem pushforward_sections_finite_projective_of_locallyTrivial_curve
    (C : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)))
    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    [GeometricallyIntegral C.hom]
    (L : C.left.Modules) (hL : LineBundle.IsLocallyTrivial L) :
    letI : Module k Γ((Modules.pushforward C.hom).obj L,
      (⊤ : (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)).Opens)) :=
      Module.compHom _ (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of k)).inv.hom
    Module.Finite k Γ((Modules.pushforward C.hom).obj L,
      (⊤ : (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)).Opens)) ∧
      Module.Projective k Γ((Modules.pushforward C.hom).obj L,
        (⊤ : (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)).Opens)) ∧
      Module.finrank k Γ((Modules.pushforward C.hom).obj L,
        (⊤ : (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)).Opens)) =
        Module.finrank k Γ(L, (⊤ : C.left.Opens)) := by
  letI : Module k Γ((Modules.pushforward C.hom).obj L,
      (⊤ : (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)).Opens)) :=
    Module.compHom _ (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of k)).inv.hom
  letI : Module.Finite k Γ(L, (⊤ : C.left.Opens)) :=
    module_finite_sections_of_locallyTrivial_curve C L hL
  letI := C.hom.baseSectionsModule L (⊤ : C.left.Opens)
  let γ := Scheme.Modules.pushforwardTopEquivBaseSections C.hom L
  let e : Γ((Modules.pushforward C.hom).obj L,
      (⊤ : (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)).Opens)) ≃ₗ[k]
      Γ(L, (⊤ : C.left.Opens)) :=
    { toFun := γ
      invFun := γ.symm
      left_inv := γ.left_inv
      right_inv := γ.right_inv
      map_add' := γ.map_add
      map_smul' := by
        intro a z
        change γ ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of k)).inv.hom a • z) = _
        rw [γ.map_smul]
        rw [Scheme.Hom.baseSectionsModule_smul_def]
        have hmap : C.hom.appLE (⊤ : (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)).Opens)
            (⊤ : C.left.Opens) (by simp) = C.hom.appTop := by
          convert Scheme.Hom.appLE_eq_app C.hom
            (U := (⊤ : (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)).Opens)) using 1 <;> simp
        rw [hmap]
        exact (moduleKSections_smul_top C L a (γ z)).symm }
  refine ⟨Module.Finite.equiv e.symm, Module.Projective.of_equiv e.symm, ?_⟩
  exact e.finrank_eq

set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
/-- The pushforward of a line bundle on a proper smooth curve is locally free
of the dimension of its curve sections. -/
theorem pushforward_isLocallyFreeOfRank_of_locallyTrivial_curve
    (C : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)))
    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    [GeometricallyIntegral C.hom]
    (L : C.left.Modules) (hL : LineBundle.IsLocallyTrivial L) :
    SheafOfModules.IsLocallyFreeOfRank ((Modules.pushforward C.hom).obj L)
      (Module.finrank k Γ(L, (⊤ : C.left.Opens))) := by
  letI : Module k Γ((Modules.pushforward C.hom).obj L,
      (⊤ : (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)).Opens)) :=
    Module.compHom _ (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of k)).inv.hom
  obtain ⟨hfin, hproj, hdim⟩ :=
    pushforward_sections_finite_projective_of_locallyTrivial_curve C L hL
  letI : L.IsFinitePresentation := hL.isFinitePresentation
  letI : L.IsQuasicoherent := by infer_instance
  letI : QuasiCompact C.hom := by infer_instance
  letI : QuasiSeparated C.hom := by infer_instance
  letI : ((Modules.pushforward C.hom).obj L).IsQuasicoherent :=
    Modules.pushforward_isQuasicoherent C.hom L
  letI := hfin
  letI := hproj
  letI : Module.Free k Γ((Modules.pushforward C.hom).obj L,
      (⊤ : (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)).Opens)) :=
    Module.Free.of_divisionRing _ _
  apply Modules.isLocallyFreeOfRank_of_finite_projective_sections
    ((Modules.pushforward C.hom).obj L) hfin hproj
  intro t
  change Module.rankAtStalk Γ((Modules.pushforward C.hom).obj L,
      (⊤ : (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)).Opens)) t = _
  rw [Module.rankAtStalk_eq_finrank_of_free]
  exact hdim

end AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme
